_comment: Recipes of the stage-2 marketing office (room 31) and reception (room 26), prefix marketing.

Advertising campaigns: 4 records of 28 bytes at 0x4595b9 (0 Lula Promotion Tour, 1 Ads, 2 Posters, 3 TV ads; DDF 0x3a controls 2-5, callback 0x42f03d): +0 price (25000, 14000, 8500, 160000), +4 value (25, 15, 10, 50; set by 0x402f72 only, never read), +8/+0xc/+0x10 day, month, year started (0x4052ed), +0x14 duration in days (20, 40, 60, 45), +0x18 = 1 running. The day end 0x42f2ba stops a campaign when 0x405314(date) > duration and returns 25 * (campaigns that were running) to the warehouse 0x42ab22.

Scandals: 10 records of 16 bytes at 0x459629 (DDF 0x3b controls 2-11, callback 0x42f183): +0 price (35000, 28000, 64000, 12000, 80000, 15000, 70000, 30000, 10000, 180000), +4 points added to 0x458375 when it breaks, +8 = 1 prepared (paid), +0xc = 1 broken. At 10:00 in stage 2, 0x42f334 walks the prepared and not yet broken scandals in index order and breaks the first one with rand() % 100 > 50 (at most one a day): newspaper 0x43015e (string 1607 + index), 0x458375 += points, +0xc = 1.

marketing_poor.note: prod_s2staff with the account patched to 30000. With the credit line 0x455684 = 70000 the stage-2 check 0x40561d (account + credit line >= price) allows 100000 $: TV ads (160000) and the President scandal (180000) are refused with string 903, Lula Promotion Tour (25000) is allowed. Name and Load-dialog entry stay 'ProdAll' (300,119).

marketing_ads.note: prod_s2staff after the game itself started two advertising campaigns (Lula Promotion Tour 25000 $, Posters 8500 $) and prepared three scandals (index 3 dildos 12000 $, 5 photos from airplane 15000 $, 8 condoms 10000 $) in the marketing office (script marketing_ads.txt), saved on the WET plot as 'MktAds' in slot 4 (Load-dialog entry 300,119) at about 9:20. Then the clock is patched to 9:50, so the 10:00 scandal roll 0x42f334 comes about 2.5 s after loading.

marketing_news.note: marketing_ads after the 10:00 scandal roll (script marketing_news.txt): the game broke scandal 3 (dildos, the first prepared one; rand() seeded from the runner's fixed LULA_CLOCK passes on the first roll), showed the newspaper on the WET plot and was saved there as 'MktNews' in slot 4 (300,119). The check proves what 0x42f334 does after the newspaper: 0x458375 += 5 (scandal 3 points), scandal 3 +0xc = 1 (broken, still prepared), scandals 5 and 8 still waiting, account unchanged. Then the date is patched to Tuesday 1-2-1997 9:50 (day 0x45569c = 2, weekday 0x4556b8 = 1), so the next 10:00 roll comes about 2.5 s after loading without a day end in between (a real day end here runs the 9:00 trash event 0x40e4a4, whose 0x40716d clock jump of 2 hours skips the 10:00 hook).
